== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Aether]] [[Technicians]] are specialized individuals possessing a unique affinity for [[Aethertech]], the advanced technology of the galaxy. While they are not typically known for prowess in direct combat, they serve vital roles as engineers, pilots, and specialists capable of awakening drones, managing internal ship systems, and performing complex repairs. Their abilities vary based on their specific gifts; for example, some possess talents for synthesizing materials, creating starships, or working with weaponry. Some even specialize in highly specific areas, such as the creation and maintenance of androids or biotech. While there are tens of thousands of [[Technicians]] across the galaxy, Master [[Aether]] [[Technicians]] are exceptionally rare. Humanity is recognized as having the greatest natural talent for creating [[Aethertech]], a legacy tied to the creators of the legendary [[Zenith Devices]]. However, certain species, such as the [[Karoshan]], possess a unique limitation where they can modify, repair, and improve existing technology but lack the ability to create [[Aethertech]] from scratch. The role of a Technicians{{!}}Technician is highly valued, with elite individuals often serving as essential crew members or specialized engineers for advanced starships and massive industrial [[fabricators]].}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|As a specialized professional, Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell is a highly gifted [[Aether]] Technicians{{!}}Technician. Recognized as one of the top practitioners in the galaxy, Mell D-One-Twenty-Five{{!}}Mell was originally cloned using the DNA of four different human [[Aether]] [[Technicians]]. These technicians are hired by [[the Advocates]] at competitive rates and must wear fully contained, masked suits while performing their duties. Their unique gifts allow them to influence the specific features of [[Nova-Bots]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
